avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 and CYP1A2 induction reduces eltrombopag plasma concentrations
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplements

avoid_supplements.name: High-dose Vitamin K supplements
avoid_supplements.mechanism: May potentiate thrombotic effects and alter anticoagulation balance
avoid_supplements.action: Limit vitamin K supplementation; maintain consistent dietary intake instead

caution_supplements.name: Calcium supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May chelate eltrombopag and reduce absorption if taken concurrently
caution_supplements.action: Separate administration by at least 2-4 hours from eltrombopag dosing

caution_supplements.name: Iron supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May chelate eltrombopag and reduce gastrointestinal absorption
caution_supplements.action: Space dosing 2-4 hours apart; monitor platelet response

avoid_foods.name: Dairy products (with eltrombopag)
avoid_foods.mechanism: Calcium in dairy significantly reduces eltrombopag bioavailability by 70-80%
avoid_foods.action: Take eltrombopag on empty stomach, 1 hour before or 2 hours after dairy/calcium-rich foods

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May slightly delay absorption but does not significantly reduce bioavailability
caution_foods.action: Administer on empty stomach for optimal absorption; consistent timing recommended

caution_foods.name: Grapefruit/grapefruit juice
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may modestly increase eltrombopag levels
caution_foods.action: Limit grapefruit consumption; monitor for increased adverse effects

monitoring_notes: Platelet counts must be monitored regularly (baseline and during therapy) as eltrombopag has a narrow therapeutic window and risk of thrombosis. Strict adherence to empty stomach administration (no food 1 hour before, 2 hours after) is critical given the major interaction with calcium-containing products.
